_about: English interface strings for Wordshelf. 't' = exact texts; 'p' = patterns: {0},{1}… are values filled in by the page. Keep every placeholder. A placeholder may also be written with plural forms, e.g. {0:one=слово;few=слова;many=слов;other=слова} (categories from Intl.PluralRules for the language).
